description: Test suite for Telegram bot helper functions and resolve functions, verifying behavior of message handling, forwarding, thread parameters, and mention detection.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumThreadId
methods.description: Determines the thread ID for a forum or message based on input parameters.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Checks or fetches whether a chat is a forum based on chat attributes or API call.

methods.name: buildTelegramThreadParams
methods.description: Constructs thread-related parameters for Telegram API requests.

methods.name: buildTelegramRoutingTarget
methods.description: Builds a routing string for Telegram messages, including topic IDs if applicable.

methods.name: buildTypingThreadParams
methods.description: Creates thread parameters for typing indicators.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDirectPeerId
methods.description: Chooses between sender ID and chat ID for direct messaging.

methods.name: normalizeForwardedContext
methods.description: Extracts and formats forwarded message context into a normalized structure.

methods.name: describeReplyTarget
methods.description: Analyzes a reply message to extract referenced message information and forwarded context.

methods.name: expandTextLinks
methods.description: Replaces text_link entities with Markdown links within message text.

methods.name: hasBotMention
methods.description: Determines if a message text mentions the bot, based on username patterns and entities.
